<includeonly><div class="mp-button {{{class|}}} {{#if: {{{progressive|}}} | mp-button-progressive}} {{#if: {{{icon|}}} | mfw-icon mfw-icon-{{{icon}}}}}">{{#if: {{#pos: {{{1}}} | // }} | [{{{1}}} <span>{{{2|{{{1}}}}}}</span>] | [[:{{{1}}}|<span>{{{2|{{{1}}}}}}</span>]] }}</div></includeonly><noinclude>A main page button (minecraft.wiki's <code>mainpage button</code>).
